study.title: Cancer mortality risk from short-term PM2.5 exposure and temporal variations in Brazil

outcomes.provider: Brazilian Ministry of Health, Sistema de Informacoes sobre Mortalidade (SIM)
outcomes.scope: Resident death records for all 27 Brazilian federative units, 2015--2019.

exposure.provider: OpenAQ v3 and historical OpenAQ S3 archive through AERIS
exposure.scope: Daily unweighted mean across AERIS-discovered PM2.5 monitors within the Brazil boundary, 2015--2019.

recovery.provider: Instituto de Energia e Meio Ambiente (IEMA)
recovery.scope: Standardized public state-monitor archives used after the AERIS/OpenAQ archive audit found only 100 days. The retained 2015--2019 PM2.5 record covers CE, ES, MG, RJ, and SP.

weather.scope: Daily unweighted mean temperature and relative humidity at retained AERIS monitor coordinates.
